acceptance: DOMAIN_NODE_KINDS and DOMAIN_NODE_KIND_SPECS include exactly the four new reference node kinds with deterministic closed field schemas while all previously qualified node kinds remain compatible.
Focused positive and negative tests prove required fields, optional fields, unknown-field rejection, type validation, deterministic issue ordering, and compatibility with existing domain validators.
The implementation adds no dependency or provider/runtime side effect and the full repository format, lint, typecheck, and test suites pass on the exact candidate.
Exact candidate evidence records Diffcipline, Alibaba OCR deterministic/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused semantic-reference node validation tests plus full format/lint/typecheck/test suites.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR accounting/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: The existing Product Graph domain node-kind/spec/validator machinery already provides the correct deterministic extension point; adding a new package or abstraction would duplicate it.

requirements: Reference nodes are semantic data only and cannot grant capability, execute a Skill, mutate source, deploy a release, call a provider, or perform an external effect.
Referenced identities and revisions remain explicit data and must not be treated as proof that an external artifact exists or is trusted.

outcome: The stable Product Graph domain layer can represent design-system revision references, skill references, exploration branches, and releases as typed deterministic nodes without provider, source, deployment, or capability side effects.
rationale: IN-P02-S06-T01 is dependency-eligible because IN-P02-S02-T02 is canonically complete. The full semantic-reference task includes both node contracts and later relation semantics, so this first Grain is deliberately bounded to node contracts only.

risk.recovery: Revert the four semantic-reference node-kind/spec additions, their focused tests, exports, and evidence; all Product Graph semantics through SG-000028 remain intact.

scope_in: Add closed domain node kinds for design-system revision references, skill references, exploration branches, and releases using the existing Product Graph node contract.
Define deterministic required/optional attribute schemas for the four reference node kinds, including stable referenced revision/identity fields and explicit human-inspectable metadata.
Extend domain validation and focused tests so malformed or unknown reference fields fail closed and canonical JSON identity remains deterministic.
Export the new node-kind vocabulary through the existing @ineractive/product-graph public surface without adding a package or runtime dependency.
scope_out: No semantic edges such as bound_to, may_use, forks, promotes, or targets; those remain a later bounded S06 slice.
No source bindings, design compiler behavior, Skill execution, exploration worktree creation, release deployment, provider calls, secrets, network access, or external effects.
No Dataset/ProductCompleteness work and no change to P02-S03 Change Intent or P02-S04 Question Gate semantics.
